pages.text: The power component at the center of the $(l:advanced/geothermal_core)Geothermal Core$(/l), your endgame heat source.$(br2)$(bold)Needs:$() a diamond, blue ice, $(l:advanced/ice_shards)ice shards$(/l) and frozen obsidian, which forms on the surface from Phase 4.$(br2)$(italic)"Cryogenic Thermal Inversion Matrix" did not fit on the label.$()
Cold things around a diamond somehow make heat. ORSA Physics wrote "it works" and stopped.
